_about: Design tokens for the quick-capture notepad. LIGHT theme. tokens.dark.json holds the DARK theme with the same role names; the app picks one from the Windows setting. Values are a neutral placeholder palette: replica-brand swaps them for the real brand. These were designed from roles and Windows conventions, not measured from screenshots of other apps (replica/screens/ is empty on purpose). Check with: python3 contrast.py tokens.json and tokens.dark.json
accent_source: Use the Windows system accent colour when available and the theme's accent as the fallback. The contrast of the Windows accent against bg is checked at runtime; if it falls under 4.5:1 for text or 3:1 for rings, fall back to the token.

font.sans: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, sans-serif
font.display: Segoe UI Variable Display, Segoe UI, sans-serif
font._note: All system fonts: Segoe UI Variable ships with Windows 11 and falls back to Segoe UI on Windows 10; Cascadia Mono is open source (SIL OFL) and falls back to Consolas. Nothing to bundle, nothing licensed from another app.

editor._note: size comes from the text_size setting (11 to 28); line height is 1.5 times the size

radius._note: window corners use 8 on Windows 11 through the system corner preference and 0 on Windows 10

shadow._note: the capture window uses the system shadow; pop is for menus and the toast

motion.window_show: fade 100ms, no slide: the window must be typeable instantly
motion.reduce: when Windows animations are off, every duration becomes 0

icons.set: Lucide (ISC license), embedded as XAML path geometry
